title: Parking, Recreational Vehicle and Guest Figures for Community Rules & Site Care
content:
The parking and guest figures below are part of every Community Rules & Site Care plan and do not vary from the Self-Maintained Site through the Complete Site Care Plan (Lawn Mowing Plan, Lawn & Trim Plan, Full Lawn Care Plan and Full Lawn & Snow Care Plan included).

## Vehicles

| Figure | Every plan |
|---|---|
| Included registered vehicles per site | 2 |
| Monthly extra-vehicle permit fee, per permit | $15.00 per month |
| Most registered vehicles a site may park | 3 |
| Recreational vehicle, boat or trailer parked on the home site beyond loading and unloading | not allowed |
| Hours a recreational vehicle, boat or trailer may stand on the site for loading or unloading | 24 hours |

## Guests

| Figure | Every plan |
|---|---|
| Consecutive days after which a guest's stay must be registered | 7 days |
| Most consecutive days a registered guest may stay before applying as an occupant on the lease | 30 days |

## Points of reading

- **Hypothetical illustration.** A boat brought onto the site for loading may stand there for up to 24 hours.
- **Hypothetical illustration.** A guest whose stay runs 7 consecutive days has not passed the registration threshold; a stay that runs an eighth consecutive day has.
- No site may park more than 3 registered vehicles, whatever its permits.
